categories.main_business_segments: MatsukiyoCocokara&Co. operates three main business segments: (1) Matsumotokiyoshi Group, which manages drugstores and insurance dispensing pharmacies, including franchise operations; (2) Cocokara Fine Group, which also manages drugstores and dispensing pharmacies, as well as care facilities and related services; and (3) Management Support, which provides procurement, management, and support services to group companies, including private brand product development and indirect operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced retail and pharmacy management systems, digital transformation (DX) initiatives, and data-driven marketing. It emphasizes seamless integration of physical stores and digital platforms (apps, e-commerce), efficient supply chain management, and the development of private brand (PB) products, including innovative health and beauty offerings.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are general consumers seeking health, beauty, and daily necessities, with a focus on urban populations and health-conscious individuals. The company also serves elderly populations through its pharmacy and care businesses, and targets inbound tourists, especially in metropolitan areas. B2B customers include franchisees and care facilities.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Japan, with a strong presence in major metropolitan areas such as Tokyo, Osaka, and other urban centers. It also has an expanding international footprint, with stores in Thailand, Taiwan, Vietnam, Hong Kong, and Guam, and is pursuing further growth in ASEAN markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: MatsukiyoCocokara&Co. is primarily positioned downstream as a retailer and pharmacy operator, but also has midstream functions through its management support segment, which handles procurement, logistics, and product development for group companies and franchisees.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the store network in key urban areas, accelerating M&A, promoting digital transformation for customer convenience and operational efficiency, and strengthening the integration of drugstore and pharmacy services. The company is also investing in sustainability (CO2 reduction, eco-friendly products), human capital, and global expansion, with a focus on health, beauty, and wellness innovation.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through the sale of pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, daily goods, and food products at its retail stores and pharmacies. Additional revenue streams include dispensing pharmacy services, franchise fees, B2B product supply, and advertising/marketing services for manufacturers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other large Japanese drugstore chains such as Tsuruha Holdings, Welcia Holdings, Sugi Holdings, and Sundrug, as well as supermarkets, convenience stores, discount stores, and e-commerce platforms. MatsukiyoCocokara&Co. is positioned as one of the largest and most recognized drugstore/pharmacy groups in Japan, with a leading brand and significant scale.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated sales reached ¥1,061.6 billion, with operating profit of ¥82.1 billion and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of ¥54.7 billion. The company has demonstrated steady organic growth, supplemented by M&A, and maintains a strong balance sheet with high equity ratio and robust cash flow. Store count and customer touchpoints continue to expand both domestically and internationally.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: MatsukiyoCocokara&Co. differentiates itself through a comprehensive health and beauty offering, a wide and innovative private brand portfolio, seamless integration of digital and physical customer experiences, and a strong focus on customer convenience and expertise in pharmacy services. The company emphasizes its ability to deliver unique value and experiences tailored to diverse customer needs, supported by a trusted brand and extensive store network.
